assumptions.A1: composition is declared as concatenation; a declaration that renumbered the second response against the intermediate state is a different operation and is not run here
assumptions.A2: the rectangle is reachability-bounded at depth two; a count here is a count over that rectangle and not over the states
assumptions.A3: the sealed enumerator remains the authority on which responses exist; the constructed self-loop probes ask the absorption question directly and are labelled as constructed, not enumerated
assumptions.A4: additivity is a property of every difference cost, so observing it for one functional is evidence about the shape of the cost and not about the choice of functional
assumptions.A5: zero circulation is a limitation, not a virtue; nothing here says a difference cost is a good cost

declared.composition: concatenation of item sequences; declared, not discovered
declared.rectangle: the sealed readings' genesis states plus every state reachable by up to two valid one-item responses, deduplicated by regime equality
